vBRIEFInfo.description: Five transport adapters: WebSocket, WebRTC DataChannel, TCP, stdio, QUIC/WebTransport

narratives.Description: Implement one TransportAdapter per spec-defined transport in src/transports/. Each adapter implements the interface { send(data: Uint8Array): void; receive(): AsyncIterable<Uint8Array>; close(): void }. websocket-adapter.ts: wraps native WebSocket (browser) or Node.js built-in WebSocket/ws; no magic bytes. webrtc-adapter.ts: wraps RTCDataChannel (browser/node-datachannel); no magic bytes. tcp-adapter.ts: wraps Node.js net.Socket; writes and validates OMUX magic. stdio-adapter.ts: wraps process.stdin/stdout; writes and validates OMUX magic. quic-adapter.ts: wraps WebTransport stream; no magic bytes. Transport adapters are tree-shakeable separate entry points. Node.js-specific adapters (tcp, stdio) are in Node-only entry points; browser-safe adapters (websocket, webrtc, quic) have no Node.js API imports.
